problem_type: Retired active storyboard projections re-enter persisted records beside their canonical multi-document owner
symptom: The canonical writer and projection invariant tests fail; nine receipt tests crash inside selectActiveStoryboardDesign before queue behavior can execute.
direct_cause: Session still samples and writes the selected plan/committed projection and normalizePayload re-emits it. Raw flat legacy records also lose migration fields in the intermediate legacy record projection.
class_root: Read-only legacy inputs must be normalized from their original source into one canonical design map, and no writer may persist an active-view projection as independent project state.
affected_population: Current multi-document projects with multiple inactive designs
Project switch, delayed save receipt and failure propagation paths
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi project/document domain ownership. Existing schemas, raw-input migration, document slice and repository/session readers and writers fully determine it; no external or Provider behavior is assumed.
invariants: Only canonical storyboardDesignsByDocumentId is written; legacy projections remain read-only input compatibility
Canonical maps, including explicitly empty maps, are authoritative over retired inputs; do not resurrect deleted plans
Raw version 1/2 and flat legacy records reach migration before schema stripping can erase retired source keys
Keep all legal documents/designs/plans, committed/status fields, node association identities, Film Bible and user-authored prompt/parameter/meta content
Do not change debounce, subscription cutover, receipt waiting or error propagation; original nine receipt assertions and their empty store mock remain unchanged
No daily projects, real media, Provider, PNG, baseline, checker or model surface changes

door_reduction.why_not: Application export, selected-node transfer, session autosave, repository read/save and hydration are legitimate distinct entry points; retain them and repair their existing shared schema/normalizer/session boundaries.

generality_proof: Real stores and repository read/save with isolated in-memory Web Storage exercise legacy single/map, current multi-design and version-2 records through migration, hydration, full-owner sampling, asynchronous canonical save receipt, serialized record and reload. Compare complete plans, all documents and design identities and original node/user metadata. Independent tests prove empty-owner precedence and raw flat migration; all original failing and receipt assertions are retained.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Consume validated original legacy inputs, prefer complete canonical ownership and return only canonical project state
Give the actual raw input to migration for both wrapped and flat legacy records
Snapshot all owner designs without reading selected storyboard projections
Describe canonical persisted output while legacy raw migration stays in its existing owner

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual save calls normalizePayload before writing either local Storage or desktop project records; the test executes this function rather than mocking its payload.
Hydration already restores the complete design map through the real document owner and keeps the existing guard/receipt lifecycle.
Legacy null/false input placeholders remain outside this scope; their actual persistence still goes through repository normalizePayload, which emits no retired projection.

recurrence.reason: Any active-only writer or intermediate parsed legacy object can truncate inactive document content or recreate dual source state on every save/reload.
same_class_scan: Generated 9 actual direct doors for session/schema/normalizer and followed repository save to normalization
Read document slice hydrate/select semantics and current multiple-design owner type
Read v1/v2 and flat raw record paths, canonical map precedence and plan/Film Bible validation
Read the unmodified asynchronous save/dispose/cutover implementation and all nine receipt tests
Read selected-node export input placeholders and confirmed repository normalization before persistence

prevention.invariant: All persisted storyboard content is represented solely by the canonical map after read-only migration.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed critical payload and unreadable legacy single plans/commit flags still fail closed without overwriting the existing record; unreadable legacy map entries keep their existing diagnostic policy. Null single plans are empty input. No snapshot samples an undefined selected-projection owner and no empty canonical owner is replaced by legacy content.
prevention.strategy: Remove obsolete projection writes/schema output fields in place, retain raw legacy migration and normalize only the complete canonical owner at both session and repository boundaries.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove retired active projection output paths only; raw legacy reading and deprecated input typing remain compatible and migration is directly tested.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party behavior or dependency lifecycle changes. Reuse existing Zod and state/repository APIs without changing their semantics or adding adapters in production.

migration: Existing load/save boundaries lazily migrate raw legacy single/map inputs into canonical designs, preserving supported user content and node associations. No daily project file is opened or rewritten by this task.
residual_risks: Full coordinator suite, daily App and real Electron filesystem receipt paths are not run in this bounded task
Existing schema policy strips unknown retired fields and credentials; this task does not claim recovery of already-corrupt or previously-lost content
Deprecated input-only payload typing remains for callers outside scope; actual writes are normalized before persistence
